articles.summary: Company anticipates response from FDA by mid-September 2026 on protocol submitted for planned Phase 3 study of efzofitimod in patients with pulmonary sarcoidosis with restrictive lung disease. SAN DIEGO, Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- aTyr Pharma, Inc. (Nasdaq: ATYR) (“aTyr” or the “Company”),
articles.title: aTyr Pharma Provides Update on Timing of Regulatory Response for Planned Phase 3 Study of Efzofitimod in Pulmonary Sarcoidosis
